day_shape: 57 items dominated by regime-channel messaging on the ongoing US-Iran confrontation, CENTCOM rebutting IRGC Strait of Hormuz mine claim, EASA extending Gulf airspace warning to 30 September, and Trump calling Iran a 'Failed Nation'; nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: US-Iran confrontation and Hormuz claims
threads.summary: Following overnight US strikes on Iranian military assets, a senior Iranian source told Reuters the confrontation remained 'limited and contained' while Pezeshkian said Tehran still sought a negotiated solution, and Trump declared Iran 'officially a Failed Nation'. CENTCOM publicly rejected an IRGC claim that a supertanker had struck two mines in the Strait of Hormuz as disinformation, while Defa Press claimed IRGC forces downed an MQ-9 drone east of the strait.

threads.label: Regime messaging on retaliation and US bases
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB circulated 'red revenge flags' imagery from Tehran's Khorasan Square, a 'Garment of Revenge' music video invoking Soleimani, and a purported satellite image of destroyed US hangars at Jordan's Al-Azraq base, alongside claims of US helicopters relocating from Muwaffaq al-Salti. Iran's General Staff said it would 'not tolerate aggression from any frontier,' and Araghchi said Washington must return to the 'Islamabad understanding.'

threads.label: Khamenei Government/Unity Week cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office pushed a heavy messaging cycle marking Government Week and Unity Week, including a tree diagram of the Supreme Leader's message and calls against internal 'discord'. The judiciary requested pardons or commuted sentences for 2,577 convicts to mark the Prophet's and Imam Jafar al-Sadiq's birthdays, amplified across Rahbar, IRIB and Defa Press.

threads.label: Israel operations in Gaza and Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF announced the killing of Hamas Gaza City supply-and-maintenance commander Omar Mohammed Roshdy Saraj in a Sabra neighbourhood airstrike, and named Maj. Gen. Dado Bar Kalifa as incoming Central Command chief from 2027. Defa Press and IRIB reported Israeli air and artillery strikes on southern Lebanon including alleged white phosphorus use near Ali al-Tahir, with Nabih Berri warning against Lebanese internal discord.

threads.label: Regional aviation, diplomacy and Iran domestic strain
threads.summary: EASA extended its warning to airlines to avoid Persian Gulf airspace over Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar and the UAE until 30 September, while Pezeshkian met Aliyev at the SCO summit in Kyrgyzstan and OCHA published its July humanitarian update noting 13 consecutive nights of strikes. Iran International reported the dollar trading near 2.1 million rials, public backlash to a VP's gasoline-pricing remarks, and a Tehran actor dropped over pro-Palestine statements.

events.title_en: Power Minister: Complete self-sufficiency in electricity production will soon be achieved
events.summary_en: Power Minister: Complete self-sufficiency in electricity production will soon be achieved. Abbas Aliabadi, Power Minister, emphasizing the need to increase production and manage electricity consumption, said: by implementing planned programmes, the country will soon achieve complete self-sufficiency in electricity supply and the groundwork for public participation in power plant construction will be provided. The country's electricity generation capacity has reached approximately 102,000 megawatts; a figure which, given the country's population of 85 million, is considered high capacity, but an important part of the problem returns to how consumption is managed. Unfortunately in the country we have focused solely on production rather than consumption. If electricity consumption were optimised and in line with international standards.

events.title_en: Pardon and commutation of sentences for over 2,500 convicts on the occasion of the Prophet's birth
events.summary_en: Pardon and commutation of sentences for over 2,500 convicts on the occasion of the Prophet's birth. Coinciding with the blessed days of the birth of Prophet Muhammad al-Mustafa (Peace Be Upon Him) and Imam Jafar al-Sadiq (Peace Be Upon Him), the head of the judiciary in a letter to the Supreme Leader requested pardon, commutation and alteration of sentences for 2,577 convicts from public and revolutionary courts, the judiciary organisation of the armed forces and the government punishment organisation, which His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Mujtaba Husseini Khamenei delegated decision-making in this matter to the head of the judiciary. Hojjat al-Islam wal-Muslimin Ajeha, after necessary review, issued an order to execute the pardon, commutation and alteration of sentences for these convicts.

events.title_en: Commander Abed: Khatam al-Anbiya (Peace Be Upon Him) headquarters is a strong executive arm of the government
events.summary_en: Commander Abed: Khatam al-Anbiya (Peace Be Upon Him) headquarters is a strong executive arm of the government. Commander of Khatam al-Anbiya (Peace Be Upon Him) construction headquarters said: This headquarters, as the executive arm of the government in various sectors, has created significant capacity for implementing the country's major infrastructure projects. In the electricity sector, significant capacity has been added to the country's production capacity and these measures have been taken in line with fulfilling duty and serving the people and country. In the water sector, extensive measures have been taken and approximately 27 billion cubic metres of water storage capacity has been created, which demonstrates part of the headquarters' capabilities and activities in this sector. In the fuel sector, significant capacity was created.

events.title_en: Nabih Berri warns: Israel seeks to sow discord in Lebanon
events.summary_en: Nabih Berri warns: Israel seeks to sow discord in Lebanon. Nabih Berri warned that the Zionist regime is attempting to ignite the fire of discord in Lebanon. Nabih Berri, speaker of the Lebanese parliament, said: Israel, by destroying our villages and cities, is seeking to erase our historical memory. Lebanon should not be dragged into internal wars, schisms or devastating political and security collapses. Nabih Berri warned that Israel's main objective through these actions is not Hezbollah or the Amal movement, but rather the main objective is 'sowing discord'.
